memories.name: To Suffer Without Dying
memories.objective: Break into the Port Royal prison stealthily to free Mary Read and Anne Bonny.
steps: Shake the gibbet cage until guards come and Ah Tabai arrives with your weapons.
Head southeast to the beach and take out the guard near the stairs.
Hide in bushes, whistle the alarm-bell guard down, then climb up, kill the gunner, hide the body and cut the bell.
Go to the central watchtower and take out its gunner.
Wait for the hay-cart patrol to leave, drop into cover, then climb the wall structure once guards face away.
Hide behind boxes and whistle guards over one at a time.
Go southeast through bushes past two outward-facing guards and a pacing third.
Drop into the hay pile to the northeast, climb out when clear and take the right-hand door into a corridor.
Whistle the first guard, then use the beams for two more takedowns, including a brute.
Continue east, ambushing patrolling guards from the left alcove, then double-assassinate the pair round the corner.
Clear the guards by Mary's cell and the small southeast room one at a time.
Pick up the keys, open the cell and lead Mary out, heading north.
optional: Sync the Viewpoint from the roof and central watchtower.
Collect a Data File along the wall on the southeast route.
tips: Disable alarm bells early to prevent reinforcements.
Hiding and whistling keeps the inner prison quiet.
gaps: Anne Bonny's rescue is not described despite being named in the objective.
Guard counts, full-sync conditions and detection consequences not given.

memories.name: Delirium
memories.objective: A short dreamlike memory of Edward's grief, played as a few forced assassinations.
steps: Stagger forward and assassinate the figure that appears.
Crawl on as the scene shifts underwater.
Swim to the surface.
Assassinate the figures marked in red as they appear; the memory ends when done.
tips: The page says there is no conventional objective list.
gaps: Number of targets, controls and failure conditions not given.
Identity of the red-marked figures not explained.

memories.name: ...Everything Is Permitted
memories.objective: Reunite with the Assassins at Tulum, help repel a siege and kill the captain of an anchored ship.
steps: Head to Tulum near 40,387.
Go west from arrival to find Adewale for a short talk.
Follow Ah Tabai into the Mayan temple and finish the conversation.
Go south to the shore with Ah Tabai to help defend against the siege.
Clear the beach of soldiers, which opens the way east to an anchored ship.
Dive and approach underwater, because rifle guards can snipe you.
Climb the ship's east side and use the rigging to gain height.
Air-assassinate the captain, ending the mission and sequence.
tips: Do not swim on the surface; rifle guards will see you.
The air assassination avoids a long fight with the crew.
gaps: Soldier counts and sync objectives not given.
Body text does not explain why Ah Tabai helps (only the FAQ touches on it).
